notes.title: January 3rd Update
notes.content: We adjusted the difficulty of the game by adding some HP to the player and removing some to the bosses. We noticed that level III and IV did not have a very good success rate in our achievements. We hope this will improve the game.

notes.title: Achievements and leaderboard
notes.content: We added achievements and a leaderboard. To post a score on the leaderboard, you must unlock the Extras section by completing the first chapter and play in Challenger Mode.

notes.title: Uizuno Blade will support both Oculus Rift and HTC Vive
notes.content: We decided to add Oculus Rift support to our game. Keep in mind that it requires a play area with 360° tracking. Hope you enjoy !
